'''Port Steergard''' was a maritime port<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> located on the celestial object [[Steergard]]<ref name="Map" /> in the [[Woostri sector]]'s [[Steergard system]]<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref> along the [[Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /><ref name="Map">{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}}</ref> In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="3 BBY">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" established that the events of "[[What a Festive Evening]]" take place during [[3 BBY]].</ref> [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] traveled to Port Steergard from the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] after assessing the capabilities of the [[Ghorman Front]], a rebel faction operating there. Andor, disguised as a [[fashion designer]] named Varian Skye, met with [[Luthen Rael]] at the port before the latter transported them both back to [[Coruscant]] in [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|Rael's Fondor Haulcraft]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Port Steergard appeared in the [[What a Festive Evening|sixth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> which aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
